description: Defines a C++ struct PlayerCreationParam and related functions for creating and converting player creation parameters, used in unit testing within the starboard namespace.

classes.name: PlayerCreationParam
classes.description: A C++ wrapper struct encapsulating all information needed to create a player, including DRM system, audio/video stream info, and output mode.

methods.name: ConvertTo
methods.description: Converts PlayerCreationParam to SbPlayerCreationParam, valid during the lifetime of the instance.

methods.name: CreateAudioStreamInfo
methods.description: Creates an AudioStreamInfo object based on the specified audio codec.

methods.name: CreateVideoStreamInfo
methods.description: Creates a VideoStreamInfo object based on the specified video codec.

methods.name: CreatePlayerCreationParam
methods.description: Creates a PlayerCreationParam object based on specified audio codec, video codec, and output mode.

methods.name: GetPreferredOutputMode
methods.description: Determines the preferred output mode based on the given PlayerCreationParam.
